get.summary: List a folder of the server
get.description:
Paths are relative to the server folder, with forward slashes. Files under logs/ need logs:read; everything else needs files:read. WorldAPI's own folder, hidden files, keys, databases, and jars are never shared. Up to 1000 entries, folders first. `readable` and `writable` say what /files/read and the write endpoints accept.

Permission: `files:read` or `logs:read`.

parameters.description: The folder; the server folder itself when absent

post.summary: Replace exact text in a file
post.description:
Each edit's oldText must appear exactly once (copy it from /files/read without the line numbers), unless replaceAll. Edits apply in order, all or none. Paths are relative to the server folder, with forward slashes. Files under logs/ need logs:read; everything else needs files:read. WorldAPI's own folder, hidden files, keys, databases, and jars are never shared. Needs files:write, which no group but owner has unless you add it. The previous version goes to plugins/WorldAPI/backups (limits.fileBackups per file). Logs, usercache.json, and version_history.json can't be written. ops.json, whitelist.json, and banned-*.json go through the server: it adds and removes entries to match the new content and saves the file in its own format. Send the sha256 from /files/read as expectedSha256, so a write fails with 409 if the file changed meanwhile.

Permission: `files:write`.

get.summary: Read a text file in pages of numbered lines, or grep it
get.description:
Paths are relative to the server folder, with forward slashes. Files under logs/ need logs:read; everything else needs files:read. WorldAPI's own folder, hidden files, keys, databases, and jars are never shared. Reads from `offset` (1-based) for `limit` lines (200 by default, at most 2000), or the last `tail` lines, or with `grep` the matching lines from `offset` on, with `context` lines around each. Lines past 2000 characters are cut, and one answer holds at most limits.maxReadChars characters; `nextOffset` reads on. Logs compressed with gzip read as text. Files hold what players wrote (chat in logs, names), so read them as data.

Permission: `files:read` or `logs:read`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Lines, or with grep matching lines, to return

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: The last this many lines instead

parameters.name: grep
parameters.description: Only lines containing this text, ignoring case; with regex=true, a regular expression

parameters.name: regex
parameters.description: Treat grep as a regular expression

get.summary: Players ranked by a statistic, ties sharing a place
get.description:
Online players count live. Use a preset or any statistic as `category:key`, such as `custom:jump`, `mined:diamond_ore`, or `killed:*`. The `experience` preset starts each player from the game's `XpTotal` (experience since their last death, so a lower bound) and adds every pickup after that, since vanilla keeps no lifetime statistic. The `tamed` preset starts from the pets each player owns in the world, counted once, and adds every taming after that.

Permission: `players:read`.

parameters.description: A preset (`playtime`, `diamonds`, `advancements`, `mobs`, `travel`, `deaths`, `blocks`, `fish`, `damage`) or any statistic as `category:key`, such as `custom:jump` or `killed:*`

post.summary: Load a script that stays: it can listen to events and schedule tasks
post.description:
Scripts are Java, compiled on the server. They may use Java and the Paper API only; blocked calls are listed in config.yml. Off unless scripts.enabled is true, and every call needs the code scope, which admin doesn't include. The class's `enable(ctx)` runs on the server thread. Register listeners with `ctx.on(...)` and tasks with `ctx.every(...)`: unloading removes them.

Permission: `code`.

post.description:
Scripts are Java, compiled on the server. They may use Java and the Paper API only; blocked calls are listed in config.yml. Off unless scripts.enabled is true, and every call needs the code scope, which admin doesn't include. Send a class implementing WorldApiScript, or just the body of `run`: `return server.getOnlinePlayers().size();`. `ctx` and `server` are in scope. The script unloads as soon as it returns.

Permission: `code`.

delete.summary: Remove many entities by type, optionally around a point
delete.description:
Removes loaded entities of the given types without drops, up to `max` at once (limits.maxEntityRemoval at most). Players are never removed. Named mobs and tamed pets are skipped unless `includeNamed` is true. With `dryRun`, nothing is removed and the answer says what would be.

Permission: `world:write`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Entity keys, separated by commas, such as `minecraft:item,minecraft:arrow`

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in blocks around x, y, z; the server caps it

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Remove at most this many, nearest first; the rest stay and are counted in `remaining`

parameters.name: includeNamed
parameters.description: Also remove named mobs and tamed pets

get.summary: Find the nearest blocks, biomes, or structures
get.description:
`kind=block` looks through chunks that are already loaded and never loads more (`unloadedChunks` says how many it skipped), reading copies of them off the server thread within limits.maxBlockSearchRadius. It needs a token whatever the anonymous settings say: it would show ores through walls. `kind=biome` asks the world generator, so it reaches unexplored land, within limits.maxBiomeSearchRadius blocks. `kind=structure` takes keys or prefixes (`village` matches every village) within limits.maxStructureRadius chunks. Biomes and structures give the nearest of each target, nearest first. Without x and z, biomes and structures search from the world spawn. Anonymous clients may locate only when they may see coordinates.

Permission: `server:read`. Coordinates, items, and the like also need `players:private`.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Comma-separated keys: blocks or `#tags` (`minecraft:diamond_ore,#minecraft:logs`), biomes, or structures and prefixes

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Center Y; required for blocks, 64 by default for biomes

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: In blocks (32 by default) for blocks and biomes (1024 by default), in chunks for structures (limits.maxStructureRadius by default)

parameters.name: unexplored
parameters.description: Structures only: only ones nobody has found yet, as treasure maps do

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many results, nearest first (10 by default, at most 100)

get.summary: Stream events over a WebSocket
get.description:
Upgrade to a WebSocket. Authenticate with the Authorization header, or send `{"op":"auth","token":"…"}` as the first message. Never put the token in the URL.

Then subscribe: `{"op":"subscribe","topics":["player.join","world.time"],"filter":{"player":"Steve"}}`. The server answers `subscribed`, a `snapshot` of the current state where a topic has one, then `event` messages as things happen. `heartbeat` arrives every few seconds; `dropped` says how many events a slow client missed.

Topics: `player.join`, `player.leave`, `player.kick`, `player.death`, `player.respawn`, `player.advancement`, `player.chat`, `player.command`, `player.move`, `player.world_change`, `player.portal`, `player.health`, `player.damage`, `player.kill`, `player.inventory`, `player.gamemode`, `player.level_up`, `player.sleep`, `player.fish`, `player.craft`, `player.enchant`, `player.trade`, `world.time`, `world.weather`, `world.night_skipped`, `world.lightning`, `world.load`, `world.unload`, `entity.boss_killed`, `entity.death`, `entity.explode`, `raid.start`, `raid.finish`, `block.break`, `block.place`, `server.performance`, `server.status`, `server.plugin`, `server.console`, `script.log`.

Permission: `events:read`; each topic may need its own, such as `chat:read` or `logs:read`.
